key_insight: Inserting an ultrathin high work-function metal layer between ITO and NiOx lowers the hole-injection barrier and greatly boosts PeLED luminance.
engineering_relevance: This is a simple, scalable anode-interlayer strategy that can improve charge injection and brightness in all-inorganic perovskite LEDs without changing the core device stack.
method: Simulated device physics using drift-diffusion and Poisson equations in Setfos.
Compared thin high work-function transition metals inserted between ITO and NiOx.
Evaluated hole injection, barrier reduction, and luminance response.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that a 2 nm Au interlayer increased luminance by more than 18×, with similar improvements also seen for Pd and Pt.
watch_item: The result is simulation-based, so experimental verification is still needed to confirm device stability, uniformity, and fabrication tolerance at scale.
paper_title: Boosting Perovskite Light-Emitting Diodes Performance by Introducing High Work-function Metal Transition Layer
